recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current source already satisfies FHIR-6320 after later policy changes; adding redundant prose would risk reintroducing the outdated defaultValue-preferred framing.
issue_request: FHIR-6320 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and requested clearer definitions and examples for ElementDefinition.defaultValue[x] versus ElementDefinition.meaningWhenMissing, plus a fix for meaningWhenMissing not appearing in generated profiles.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit 950a889bea53656c82aebb7cd3365fa09e9625cc / svn revision 5494 copied meaningWhenMissing into generated profile elements. Commit bdabe8e8bd3c1f71a4c5c0c9f39880207fdafa49 / svn revision 6387 clarified the ElementDefinition spreadsheet definitions and examples.
additional_context: ElementDefinition remains an active datatype and page in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-15121 and FHIR-I WGM/Zulip discussion retained meaningWhenMissing but restricted defaultValue[x] to logical models, clarified missing-as-no-value including extension-only elements, and prevented profiles from changing missing meanings. FHIR-15121, FHIR-13337, and FHIR-16934 are already represented on the combined branch or were background decisions for this seed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml distinguishes defaultValue[x] as an assumed value when absent from meaningWhenMissing as implicit meaning when absent, explains hazards and logical-model-only default values, says missing meanings cannot be changed in profiles, and keeps the example semantics. Current source/elementdefinition.html explains missing elements and the generated default/missing list.
